text: Implemented cross-platform archive-zarr profile adapter: exact CanonicalBold [t,z,y,x] refinement, scalar calibration, affine geometry/timing agreement, typed logical/content SHA-256 identities, deterministic neuroarchive/publication codecs, complete outer-object inventories, bounded JVM/Scala.js opening without listing, immutable JVM publisher, and explicit full physical audit. Missing objects, same-length corruption, end-indexed layouts, bad scientific refinements, fill omission, and interruption are tested. Gates: archiveZarrJVM 10/10, archiveZarrJS 7/7; current Zarr-Python reads the Scala-published start-indexed sharded canonical revision exactly as shape (2,2,2,3), values 0..23.
